_doc: Bandit types (and, under 'civilians', the townsfolk). 'templates' are body shapes, baked once each. 'types' combine a template with palettes, a loadout and behaviour knobs; town.json places them and may override any type field per bandit. 'dynamite': sticks he carries (thrown at a place the stranger keeps killing from); 'fumble': chance he throws it short or drops it at his feet; 'bandages': how many he can patch himself up with when wounded; 'patch': how likely he is to break off and do it (scaled by his fear); 'gasp': how likely, downed with a pistol to hand and the stranger in sight, he props himself up for a last shot or three (less if he can hope a comrade will come for him). 'finish': how likely, the stranger down and in his sight, he walks up to finish him. 'rabble': how given he is, in a crowd of his own round the stranger, to stand there wasting it (a round at the sky, bawling the others on). Palette slots are listed in 'slots'; any slot left out keeps a neutral grey.

manhunter._doc: Silencio's bounty hunters' rank and file: patient, keeps his distance, uses cover.
manhunter.name: Manhunter

spot: Nobody's paying for that one. Kill him anyway.

sharpshooter._doc: Silencio's hunters' long guns, posted high and far along main street.
sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter

buntline._doc: The hunters' Buntline man: long black coat, the long-barrelled Colt; takes careful aim, walks up to finish a man.
buntline.name: The Buntline man

spot: Five hundred dollars. Or nothing at all.

hunter_boss._doc: The bounty hunters' boss: runs them; his death leaves them leaderless.
hunter_boss.name: The boss

spot: Nobody's paying for this one, boys.

trapper._doc: Silencio's outlaws' rank and file: mountain men gone hungry, old guns, poor shots, many of them.
trapper.name: Trapper

spot: Ain't one of them, is he?

trappeur._doc: A French-Canadian trapper among the outlaws: as the trapper, a word of French.
trappeur.name: Trapper

mountainman._doc: The outlaws' heavy: huge in a buffalo robe, tough, fights close.
mountainman.name: Mountain man

woodsman._doc: The outlaws' hunter of game: the poacher's buckskin, a long rifle, watching the pond and the cabins.
woodsman.name: Woodsman

outlaw_chief._doc: The outlaws' chief: keeps the strongbox; his death breaks the outlaws.
outlaw_chief.name: The chief

civilians._doc: Unarmed townsfolk. 'nerve': 0 freezes and cowers, 1 keeps his head and runs for a door. 'snitch': chance he runs to tell the bandits when he sees the stranger. 'palettes_from' borrows a bandit type's palettes, so an innocent can look exactly like an armed one.
